get.description: Additional OAuth2 extension. Provider definitions live in the auth configuration JSON; no provider-specific code.

get.summary: Begin Authorization Code login with PKCE
get.description: Additional OAuth2 extension. Sets a 10-minute HttpOnly state cookie and redirects to a configured provider. Client identifiers and secrets are resolved from environment variable names in configuration.

get.summary: Consume authorization code and open local session
get.description: Additional OAuth2 extension. Single-use state is bound to provider and browser cookie. Exchanges the code with PKCE, reads authenticated userinfo, and never auto-links an existing account by email. Redirects to the fixed PUBLIC_APP_URL/auth/callback; the frontend calls refresh to obtain access. No credentials appear in redirects.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes; passwords are not trimmed.

ProfilePatch.description: Email is read-only in v1. An email-change flow requires separate re-verification.

secret.description: Returned once. Only its digest is persisted.

configuration.description: Optional JSON object, defaults to {}. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL or numeric exponents outside -10000..10000. Configuration is opaque UI metadata, not an instance JSON Schema.
